entries.828c693b13b7b21e: In research and development, the company focuses on creating high value-added new products in three fields (amino acids, specialty chemicals and pharmaceuticals), and is working to develop new products in pharmaceutical-related, IT-related, polymer-related and functional materials-related fields, using pyridine, piperidine and quinuclidine derivatives and organosilicon compounds, which it positions as strategic substances.
entries.88426d9f9aa7c941: The three-year medium-term management plan starting from the fiscal year ending March 2027 sets 'Challenging a New Stage (Sustainable Growth through Enhancement of Corporate Value)' as its basic policy, and names five priority measures: promoting a growth strategy driven by a quality culture and innovation; strengthening value-creation capability through collaboration among sales, development and production; strengthening the global supply structure and increasing value added in the amino acid field; transforming the portfolio and taking on new businesses in the specialty chemicals field; and expanding the CDMO business and advancing technological innovation in the pharmaceutical field.
